headline: Sensex hits three-year low and Nifty touches 52-week low following RBI rate hike and rising crude prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI hiked interest rates for the first time in nearly four years to combat price pressure
Rising global crude oil prices are weighing heavily on market sentiment
Significant sell-off triggered by inflationary concerns and the central bank's policy shift
Weak global cues and domestic triggers leading to a fresh 52-week low for Nifty
whatHappening: Sensex plummeted over 1,000 points to reach its lowest level in three years
TCS reported that AI-led revenue has crossed $3.1 billion, accounting for 10% of its overall revenue
Dr. Reddy’s facility in Andhra Pradesh received two observations from the U.S. FDA
Airlines like Air India and Akasa have hiked fuel surcharges in response to climbing operational costs
summary: The Indian stock market faced a severe downturn with the Sensex hitting a three-year low and Nifty dropping below 22,600 following an RBI rate hike. While TCS provided a silver lining with strong AI revenue growth, broader markets were dragged down by rising crude prices and regulatory concerns for pharma majors. Investors remain cautious as key indices hit multi-year and 52-week lows amid multiple domestic and global triggers.
